patch_description: Replace the random Gaussian cloud with a deterministic maximin-code search. The search is seeded by the productive cube-plus-axis (cube–octahedron) family, with several reproducible asymmetric perturbations to escape its symmetry-locked local optimum. Each seed is refined using a continuation of smooth inverse-power approximations to the minimum distance and power approximations to the maximum distance. Centering and RMS normalization preserve the scale-invariant objective while preventing numerical drift. The best configuration is selected using the evaluator’s exact minimum/maximum distance ratio.
